title: Exquisite French Pork Confit de Porc
description: Pungent, crisp, and rich, this Lyon-inspired dish is perfect for a midnight craving.

ingredients.name: Namul-blanch-season
ingredients.notes: Or substitute with paprika and dried thyme

instructions: Season the pork pieces with salt and black pepper.
In a large bowl, combine the flour and namul-blanch-season. Toss the pork pieces to coat evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Sear the pork pieces until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the pork to a plate and set aside. Add more oil if necessary.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the water, bay leaves, and browned pork to the pot. Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven. Braise at 300°F for 2.5 hours.
Strain the juices and discard the bay leaves. Add the red wine vinegar to the pot and simmer until thickened, about 10 minutes.
Let the confit cool slightly before serving.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
